table.name: participants
table.summary: Stores information about individuals or groups participating in an event or system, including their unique ID, role classification, and personal name.

participant_category.name: participant_category
participant_category.meaning: A categorical code indicating the role or classification of the participant (e.g., Organizer vs. Participant).

id.name: id
id.meaning: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each participant record.
